title:
PrivilegedActions can only allow access to otherwise restricted actions on specific types, not subtypes. This means that allowing {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Auth#getSecret} does not allow
`getSecret` on any of its concrete subtypes. In order to enable {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Auth} extensibility and integration with the PrivilegedAction framework, we store the secrets in
this (single) concrete config type, which is then used by the {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Auth} types to retrieve the secrets.
name: GenaiCore.Llm.Auth.Secret
